title: Fibre sums of H^n-a.e. equal weights agree L^n-a.e. (Lipschitz null images; parent step 2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ; S, V ⊆ ℝ^P with S ⊆ V; G : ℝ^P → ℝ^n Lipschitz (constant L_G); F : ℝ^P → ℝ^n with F = G on V; and h, h' : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] with h = h' almost everywhere for H^n⌞S (H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P; no measurability of S, h or h' is assumed). Then the fibre-sum functions y ↦ Σ_{x ∈ S, F(x) = y} h(x) and y ↦ Σ_{x ∈ S, F(x) = y} h'(x) on ℝ^n (tsums over the subtype S ∩ F^{−1}{y}) agree for L^n-a.e. y, where L^n = volume on ℝ^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S V : Set (Euclid P)) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid n) (LG : NNReal) (h h' : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), S ⊆ V → LipschitzWith LG G → EqOn F G V → h =ᵐ[μHE[n].restrict S] h' → (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(S ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h' x)
